mapper.select: SELECT FPV.VALUATION FROM ( SELECT max(FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION.VAL_DATE) valDate, FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION.FINPROD_ID, FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION.FINPROD_TYPE2 FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION WHERE FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION.VAL_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION.FINPROD_ID, FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION.FINPROD_TYPE2) T LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = T.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = T.FINPROD_TYPE2 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION FPV ON FPV.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID AND FPV.FINPROD_TYPE2 = T.FINPROD_TYPE2 AND FPV.VAL_DATE = T.valDate WHERE T.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
select PROD_REGIST_CODE from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T1 inner join FIN_PRODUCT T2 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID where T2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{product} and T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{portfolioId}
select TYPE_7 from FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT DISTINCT TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.UNIT_CPRICE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL
WHERE TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.COUNTER_ID = #{portfolioIdOut} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = 'T01' AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_OUT_TRADE = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.UNIT_CPRICE FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL
WHERE WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.COUNTER_ID = #{portfolioIdOut} AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = 'T01' AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_OUT_TRADE = 'N'
